course_name_en: Power Quality in Electrical Power Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Provides solutions to power quality problems.

syllabus_topics: Causes and general classification of power quality problems
Non-sinusoidal waves and analysis. Fourier analysis
Definitions and concepts related to harmonic magnitudes
Non-linear elements and circuits containing harmonic components
Resonance in power systems and the resonance effect of harmonics
Standards related to power quality and harmonics
Power factor correction in harmonic circuits
Filtering of harmonics and passive filter design
Passive filter application in MATLAB Simulink
bibliography: Elektrik Tesislerinde harmonikler, [docente], Yrd. Doç. [docente] vd. Birsen yayınevi, 2003.
Electrical Power Systems Quality, Roger Dugan, Mark McGranaghan, Surya Santoso, H. Wayne Beaty, mcgraw hill, 2004
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
